description: This file defines a controller class 'BestSeller' for managing bestseller modules in the OpenCart administration interface. It handles CRUD operations, report generation, installation, uninstallation, and synchronization of Bestseller modules within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class for managing bestseller modules within the OpenCart admin panel, including CRUD operations, reports, installation, uninstallation, and synchronization functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main view for the bestseller module settings page, loading language, module info, and common layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating module settings via POST request with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the bestseller module, if user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the bestseller module, if user has permission.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new bestseller module instance.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the bestseller report including pagination.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes product total sales data with the bestseller list, supporting paginated processing.
